subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Fontaine Research Institute

741270101.text: ...Just like I stressed before, dear Gestionnaire, that's how the procedure goes and there's nothing I can do.

741270102.text: Mr. Roialte did send the list of required documents and I do have them ready.

741270103.text: However, you can't simply come over and take any document. That does not conform with our letter delivery regulations.

741270108.text: You as well. It's all thanks to the help I've received from Mr. Roialte and Mr. Semaine.

741270110.text: #Of course. {NICKNAME} did me a huge favor before. Without {M#him}{F#her}, I wouldn't still be working at the Maison Gestion.

741270111.text: #Really? No wonder {NICKNAME} is an Honorary Senior Researcher of the Institute, hahahaha!

741270106.text: #{NICKNAME}! So glad to see you. What luck!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Mary-Ann Memorial Park
Defeat all of the malfunctioning meka

741270201.text: Uh, is this the Mary-Ann Memorial Park? I can't tell it's a park at all...

741270202.text: Mr. Roialte will be disappointed. He was hoping to have someone make a speech here.

741270203.text: Looking around, a speech is out of the question. There's not even an iconic landmark here, and it's not good for group photos.

741270204.text: You can take some meka back with you as a memento.

741270205.text: You're funny, but there's no room in the Maison Gestion for such things.

741270206.text: And even if I could, I'd still have to have the meka appraised, reported, categorized, then stored...

741270207.text: Hey! We're only joking. No need to get so focused on work all of a sudden...

741270208.text: Speaking of reports... I still can't get that document. Mr. Roialte will be disappointed again...

741270210.text: Not exactly. My request was not quite by-the-book, so it's no surprise that he rejected it.

741270212.text: As you may know, the Institute is making plans to rebuild, right? Certain resources and personnel arrangements have to be made through the Maison Gestion.

741270213.text: The Maison Gestion takes this matter very seriously, so it had Mr. Roialte select a team to conduct field studies in and around the vicinity.

741270214.text: Therefore, Mr. Roialte stayed behind at the Maison Gestion to do the head count, while I am to visit the Institute to coordinate the reception.

741270215.text: It happens that the Institute has a letter for the Maison Gestion, so I thought since I'm here already, I might as well bring it back with me...

741270216.text: But Mr. Choiseul insisted it was a violation of proper procedure and simply would not give it to me.

741270218.text: There are proper procedures for picking up a document?

741270219.text: Uh, don't tell Paimon there's gonna be running around for approvals, signatures, and listening to bureaucrats babble on endlessly as well...

741270220.text: Simply put, most official correspondence within the Maison Gestion must be mailed.

741270221.text: What? Then... What if the departments mailing the letter are on the same street, or even right across from each other?

741270222.text: Yes, you still have to mail it. That's for the purpose of being "traceable."

741270223.text: Gestionnaires sure aren't afraid of work.

741270224.text: I suppose everyone is just used to it all by now...

741270225.text: Never mind, let's just go to the next spot. Let me check the memo Mr. Roialte left for me... Uh...

741270226.text: This place is called... the Institute's Academic Assembly Hall. Strange... I didn't see any buildings with such a sign when I came.

741270227.text: I know where it is, just follow me.

741270228.text: I knew I could depend on you! What would I do without you?

741270229.text: Let's hurry, then. There might be more out-of-control meka around here...

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Academic Assembly Hall

741270301.text: Is this the Academic Assembly Hall?

741270302.text: I admit, the structure does look like a hall, but what's academic about it?

741270305.text: All right, good thing I didn't come for anything academic today. Anyway, the building seems relatively... intact.

741270306.text: Intact is all it has left.

741270307.text: Ahem! Come on, let's look around. I think this place is perfect for a group photo.

741270308.text: I should go find a good vantage point so I won't be at a complete loss if Mr. Roialte grills me.

741270309.text: #Please take a few pictures for me too, {NICKNAME}. I heard you're a good photographer, certainly better than me!

subQuests.subQuestName: Take pictures around the perimeter and give them to Iaune
Take pictures around the perimeter and give them to Iaune

741270901.text: This one isn't bad... Have you finished taking pictures yet?

741270904.text: Once you're done, please show them to me.

741270401.text: Oh my... Too high, far too high!

741270402.text: Are you describing the Institute's academic level?

741270403.text: No, I'm marveling at the height of this place! Though the Institute's academics were certainly up there too...

741270404.text: But now... *sigh* Who could've foreseen so many hardships for the Institute? And who knows how smooth the reconstruction will be...

741270405.text: The last stop is... The Fontaine Research Institute Qualifications Review Representative Office.

741270407.text: Thank you. But where is it? I didn't notice any such office in the Institute.

741270408.text: Is Desnos in charge of the office?

741270409.text: Yes! That's right! You know even this place? I shouldn't be surprised that the Honorary Senior Researcher knows everything about the Institute!

741270410.text: Oh, Paimon remembers now! Is it that office in the ruins? If you can count that as an office...

741270411.text: Maybe Mr. Desnos shortened the name to make it easy for you to understand.

741270412.text: Please lead the way. I have to get some files from Mr. Desnos too. Once I have them, I can return to the Maison Gestion.

741270413.text: It's been such an uneventful day today. I should be able to go back and relax soon. The Fontaine Research Institute sure does things differently from... Ahem, I didn't say a thing.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Qualifications Review Representative Office

741270501.text: O Archons save me, may no more meka cause trouble... What are you doing here, Iaune?

741270502.text: Mr. Roialte has sent me here to conduct an inspection, so I thought I'd drop by and bring you some coffee.

741270503.text: But I have to say that your working environment is indeed... quite difficult. I thought this "office" would at least have an actual room.

741270504.text: Thank you for the coffee, my dear Iaune. As for the work environment... I'm content with what I have. Look around, at least I'm working under an intact ceiling.

741270505.text: Are you still in charge of the qualifications review?

741270506.text: #{NICKNAME}! No... I should call you Honorary Senior Researcher! Glad to see you.

741270507.text: And what's with that sad look, Iaune?

741270509.text: With a long face, Iaune recounts all that has happened...

741270510.text: Hmm... Is the correspondence some sort of classified document?

741270511.text: It can't be. Replies like this are typically in the vein of "Got it," "I have no questions," "I don't know," or something similar...

741270512.text: At most, it's copied to different departments to let them know it's something they should care about.

741270513.text: Oh, no wonder I got a copy of the letter too... Have a look, is this it?

741270514.text: What!? But Mr. Choiseul clearly said he hadn't mailed it yet!

741270515.text: ...Oh, he must've meant that the external letters haven't been sent out yet.

741270516.text: Once more, he failed to tell the whole story.

741270517.text: People from the Institute are really good at getting under your skin, huh...

741270518.text: Judging from your reaction, this must be the document you wanted. I've read it several times already, myself.

741270519.text: This is identical to the document you wanted.

741270520.text: #Very astute, {NICKNAME}. I'm sure all the letters that Choiseul sent out are the same, Iaune.

741270521.text: Why don't you just take my copy back with you?

741270522.text: Wait, what? If Iaune takes it, then won't you have lost yours?

741270523.text: Hahahaha, look at me! Nobody will care if someone in my position accidentally loses a nonessential letter.

741270526.text: See, Iaune, I'm not just mooching coffee off you!

741270527.text: No, Monsieur, I cannot do that. It's against regulations. I'll go back and wait for the official letter to be delivered.

741270528.text: My dear Iaune, think outside the box, don't be a fool! Why must you insist on making it hard for yourself?

741270529.text: Who knows when that letter will get to you! The sooner you get it, the sooner you can start working and settle all that mess.

741270530.text: No, Monsieur. Thank you, but I will not violate regulations. My duty as a civil servant demands it.

741270531.text: #{NICKNAME}, Mr. Desnos, and Paimon, I must leave now. Mr. Roialte is still waiting for me to report back.

741270532.text: Iaune walks away with solemn, heavy steps...

741270533.text: *sigh* Iaune can be such a fool. His brains have gone all rotten, haven't they?

741270534.text: Everyone else tries to make things easier for themselves, yet he insists on going through the motions, even for small things like this.

741275101.text: Raimondo still isn't back yet... What is he up to?

741279901.text: Those meka look like they are out of control. I noticed as soon as I arrived.

741279902.text: I even took the long route just to bypass them...

741279903.text: *sigh* The Fontaine Research Institute is just letting them run wild here, and doing nothing about them...
